actual_prefill_service.scope: Recorded native batch extend geometry, including chunking/re-execution. Mixed prefill batches may include one-token decode rows. No exclusive kernel time or counterfactual saving is allocated by token count.

next_ordinary_request_native_ingress.scope: Native registration snapshots, not actual GPU prefill-token work or cache misses attributable exclusively to compaction.

dependency_topology.semantics: Declared invocation/SPAWN/JOIN identities, scoped by workflow. Internal summaries are separate from dynamic subagents. Missing creation, parent or waiter evidence stays unknown. Multiple consumers of a producer set describe dependency topology only: they do not prove identical rendered tokens, equal KV/Mamba values, compatible batch geometry, or an opportunity beyond native exact-prefix sharing. A single JOIN waiter does not exclude repeated tool-result text or shared prefixes elsewhere in the application.

scope: Per-file sealed complete-line prefixes; native may still be running. Tool/LLM spans include waiting and overlap across agents; their sums are not run time or counterfactual JCT savings. Post-hoc equal tool results do not establish state equivalence, determinism, or safe hits. Root workspace epochs are runtime observations, not read-set/env proofs. Callback output hashes include ToolMessage metadata/IDs and feedback, so equality counts cannot estimate all duplicate result content. Repeated-round decode is already spent before a tool-cache lookup; memoizing a tool alone does not remove those model requests.
